UpdateStar(T)

Updates the horizontal coordinates of the specified star based on the current time and location.

public void UpdateStar(T star)

Parameters

star T

The star whose horizontal coordinates are to be updated. The star must have a valid ChargerAstronomyShared.Domain.Horizontal.HorizontalBody property.

Remarks

This method calculates the star's equatorial coordinates using the J2000 epoch and applies corrections for aberration. It then converts the equatorial coordinates to topocentric horizontal coordinates, updating the star's altitude and azimuth.
